title: The $30 Budget Keto Board
seo_title: Cheap Keto Charcuterie Board Under $30 (5 g Net Carbs)
description: A $30 keto board for 6 from any supermarket: sharp cheddar, pepper jack, salami, pepperoni, eggs, pickles and cucumbers. About 5 g net carbs a serving.
hook: Big flavor from any supermarket: a keto board for six that costs about $21 to $30.
why: The cheapest keto foods are also some of the best board foods: block cheddar and pepper Jack you cube yourself, salami and pepperoni, and hard-boiled eggs, which make the board filling for almost nothing.

Cucumbers, celery and dill pickles supply the crunch and the sour bite, and whole-grain mustard ties it together. Cubing your own cheese is the biggest saving: pre-cut cheese can cost twice as much per ounce.

timeline.what: Hard-boil the eggs; chill them in their shells.
Take the cheddar and Jack out of the fridge.
Take out the meats. Peel and halve the eggs.
Slice the cucumber and celery; build the board.
Season the eggs with salt and pepper. Serve.

faq.q: How do you make a cheap keto board?
faq.a: Buy block cheese and cube it yourself, use salami and pepperoni rather than prosciutto, add hard-boiled eggs, and use cucumbers, celery and pickles instead of crackers.
About $21 to $30 for six people, depending on your store.
About 5 g net carbs per serving, shared by 6.
